# Unsloth - Google Gemma 3n & TTS


### Google's new Gemma 3n model and Text-to-speech support


[Unsloth AI](https://substack.com/@unsloth)


Jul 01, 2025


---


Happy July! 🦥 We’re excited to introduce lots of new updates for Unsloth:


### ✨ Gemma 3n


Run and fine-tune Google’s new Gemma 3n models. Gemma 3n supports text, image, video, and audio with 32K context. We’ve uploaded Dynamic quants, GGUFs, and released fine-tuning notebooks.


[Gemma 3n Blog](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/gemma-3n-how-to-run-and-fine-tune)


### 🦥 Unsloth Updates


-


We’ve released a new GitHub repo featuring


[100+ Unsloth notebooks](https://github.com/unslothai/notebooks)


-


Qwen3


[Advanced GRPO notebook](https://colab.research.google.com/github/unslothai/notebooks/blob/main/nb/Qwen3_(4B)-GRPO.ipynb) with our new proximity scoring reward function and priming stage to skip GRPO format learning


-


Unsloth now supports the latest vLLM, TRL, and Transformers.


-


New


[Reinforcement Learning (RL)](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/reinforcement-learning-guide) and


[LoRA hyperparameter](https://docs.unsloth.ai/get-started/fine-tuning-guide/lora-hyperparameters-guide) guide


### 🔊 Text-to-Speech (TTS)


Unsloth supports TTS and Speech-to-text (STT) models including Sesame-CSM, Orpheus, OpenAI’s Whisper. We also made extensive notebooks for TTS and a Guide.


[TTS Guide](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/text-to-speech-tts-fine-tuning)


### 🐳 DeepSeek-R1-0528


DeepSeek’s R1 update is here. Fine-tune DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3 with GRPO. Our notebook features a new reward function which increases multilingual response rates by 40%.


Our Dynamic 1-bit GGUFs shrink the full 715GB model to 162GB (-80% size).


[R1-0528 Blog](https://docs.unsloth.ai/basics/deepseek-r1-0528-how-to-run-locally)
